WalletConfigForm.aTaxCodeAndOrganizationAddress: A tax code and organization address are required — the two mandatory items on payment documents.
WalletConfigForm.checkOnTheSepayDashboardWhether: Check on the SePay dashboard: whether the account
WalletConfigForm.chooseFromTheStandardVietqrList: Choose from the standard VietQR list — typing by hand easily gets the abbreviation wrong, making the QR code point to the wrong bank.
WalletConfigForm.containingAllMandatoryContentUnderArticl: containing all mandatory content under Article 10 of Decree 123/2020/ND-CP,
WalletConfigForm.default0AWalletTopUp: Default 0%: a wallet top-up is an advance receipt; the tax obligation arises when employees redeem points for gifts. Change it on the advice of the unit's accountant.
WalletConfigForm.documentsSentToEmployeesAfterEach: Documents sent to employees after each successful top-up
WalletConfigForm.eInvoicesWithATaxAuthority: . E-invoices with a tax authority code must be issued through a registered invoice service provider. The printout states this clearly so employees do not use it for tax declarations.
WalletConfigForm.expiryOnlyClearsTheEmployeesScreen: Expiry only clears the employee's screen. Money that arrives after the order expires is still credited as usual — the system never rejects money that has reached the account.
WalletConfigForm.hasBeenLinkedAndWhetherThe: has been linked, and whether the webhook points to the system. Sending a small test transfer is the fastest way to know the whole chain works.
WalletConfigForm.legalEntityProfileCompleteForIssuing: Legal entity profile complete for issuing documents
WalletConfigForm.limitPerTopUpAndThe: Limit per top-up and the validity of the QR code
WalletConfigForm.no1StreetAWardB: No. 1, Street A, Ward B, District C, Hanoi
WalletConfigForm.noTransactionFromThisAccountHas: No transaction from this account has reached the system yet. If it has been linked on SePay and this is still empty, the account number typed here most likely differs from the linked one.
WalletConfigForm.noTransactionsReceivedFromThisAccount: No transactions received from this account yet
WalletConfigForm.pastTransactionsKeepTheOldRate: Past transactions keep the old rate in the history, so changing this number does not falsify past figures.
WalletConfigForm.putTheApiKeyInThe: Put the API key in the environment variable
WalletConfigForm.receiptsAreOffSoThisIs: Receipts are off, so this is not needed.
WalletConfigForm.sendAReceiptForEachTop: Send a receipt for each top-up
WalletConfigForm.setTheReconciliationCodePrefixTo: Set the reconciliation code prefix to
WalletConfigForm.step1CanOnlyBeDone: Step 1 can only be done on SePay; KeyGo has no API to link it for you. The account number here must match the one linked there: if they differ, the QR code points to an account SePay does not monitor — the money really moves but no transaction reaches the system.
WalletConfigForm.theAccountNumberOrBankCode: The account number or bank code is missing, so employees cannot create top-up orders yet. These are the two required fields to build the VietQR code.
WalletConfigForm.theAmountEmployeesPayForEach: The amount employees pay for each reward point
WalletConfigForm.theApiKeyIsDeliberatelyNot: The API key is deliberately not configured here: it lives on the server so it never leaks into the UI or access logs.
WalletConfigForm.theFullNumberIsThePrefix: The full number is the prefix plus the year, e.g. {{value}}{{getFullYear}}/00000001. It cannot be changed once documents have been issued in the year.
WalletConfigForm.theLegalEntityNamePerThe: The legal entity name per the business registration. Leave empty to use the saved company name.
WalletConfigForm.theMaximumAmountIsLessThan: The maximum amount is less than the minimum.
WalletConfigForm.theTransferDescriptionIsACode: The transfer description is a code generated for each order; this is only an example.
WalletConfigForm.turnOffIfTheUnitAlready: Turn off if the unit already issues e-invoices through its own provider and does not want to send two kinds of paper for the same payment.
WalletConfigForm.turnOnInTheCompanyPage: Turn on in the Company page, features tab.
WalletConfigForm.usedToBuildTheVietqrCode: Used to build the VietQR code and match transactions
WalletConfigForm.withoutItEmployeesCannotCreateTop: Without it employees cannot create top-up orders.
